title: Continuity at the colimit and the augmentation roof
statement: Use [def-sfb-internal-hom-strict-models, def-sfb-internal-hom-strict-roof]. Let I be a small filtered category whose colimits of R-module sheaves are exact, and let T:I->Mod_R have finite-free stages. Let P be K-flat [def-pc-kflat-complex], Continuous(P), and let L vanish termwise below an integer b. Write J=I_R(L), F=homFixed(P), and S=colimit T. Then (i) v_S:F(S tensor L)->F(S tensor J) is a quasi-isomorphism; (ii) the canonical cocone map colimit_i F(T_i tensor J)->F(S tensor J) is a quasi-isomorphism; and (iii) the canonical tensor cocone map colimit_i(T_i tensor F(L))->S tensor F(L) is an isomorphism. In particular (ii) requires no lower bound on J or F(L).

source.place: Lemma 6.8.12 and Proposition 6.8.14 (continuity and coefficient passage), Remark 6.8.15 (ambient operations); conditional ring-sheaf comparison is an agent formulation of the argument extracted from returned step 8, not a verbatim assertion of the source.

proof.text: Install the recorded independent-universe sheaf tensor and its proved colimit-preservation/additivity API. For a finite power of the unit, tensor is a finite product of the identity: use preservation of finite products by additive tensor functors, curriedTensor, and limitIsoFlipCompLim. Finite limits commute with this finite product, including the empty product. For the coefficient colimit S, identify tensorLeft S with the pointwise colimit of tensorLeft T_i by preservesColimitIso and colimitIsoFlipCompColim. Pointwise finite-limit preservation at the stages and exactness of the given I-colimit give finite-limit preservation by tensorLeft S. Tensor already preserves finite colimits, so all these tensor functors are exact.

Use mapBifunctorSingle₁Iso and its naturality to identify degree-zero total tensor by a module with termwise tensorLeft. Consequently the exact stage and colimit tensor functors preserve the resolution augmentation quasi-isomorphism. The fixed K-injective resolution functor preserves quasi-isomorphisms by naturality of its augmentation and two-out-of-three. Apply the universe-general quasiIso_homComplex_mapOfUniverses with identity on P to prove homFixed(P) preserves every quasi-isomorphism. This proves the roof denominator at S. K-flatness of P is not needed in this continuity subargument; its binder is retained unchanged.

The degree-zero tensor identification gives the common lower bound b on M_i=T_i tensor L. Apply the supplied Continuous(P) to M. Let N_i=T_i tensor I_R(L), with augmentation natural transformation alpha:M->N. The components of alpha and their images under homFixed(P) are quasi-isomorphisms by the preceding step. Exact I-colimits preserve both families. The colimit.post naturality square reads colim(alpha mapped by H) followed by post(N,H) equals post(M,H) followed by H(colim alpha). Two-out-of-three therefore proves post(N,H) is a quasi-isomorphism, without a bound on I_R(L). Finally colimit.post_post and preservation of coefficient colimits by degree-zero total tensor identify this with the requested coefficient cocone map. The same tensor preservation proves the last IsIso conclusion for H(L), with no boundedness assumption on H(L).

proof_origin.place: Existing ring-sheaf continuity argument, steps 2--3 and 8--9; direct Lean implementation using finite products, exact colimits and augmentation naturality. No lower truncation is needed because L is already supplied termwise bounded below.

theorem internalHom_filtered_continuity (R : Sheaf J CommRingCat.{max u v r})
    {I : Type (max u v r)} [SmallCategory I] [IsFiltered I]
    [HasColimitsOfShape I (Modules.{u, v, r} J R)]
    [HasExactColimitsOfShape I (Modules.{u, v, r} J R)]
    (T : I ⥤ Modules.{u, v, r} J R)
    (hfree : ∀ i : I, ∃ d : ℕ, Nonempty
      (T.obj i ≅ limit (Discrete.functor (fun _ : Fin d ↦
        SheafOfModules.unit ((sheafCompose J
          (forget₂ CommRingCat.{max u v r} RingCat.{max u v r})).obj R)))))
    (P L : CochainComplex (Modules.{u, v, r} J R) ℤ)
    (hP : CochainComplex.IsKFlatIndependentCoefficients (J := J) (R := R) P)
    (hcont : Continuous.{u, v, r} J R (I := I) P)
    (b : ℤ) (hL : ∀ n : ℤ, n < b → IsZero (L.X n)) :
    QuasiIso (roofDenominator.{u, v, r} J R P L (colimit T)) ∧
    QuasiIso (colimit.post T
      (tensorFixed.{u, v, r} J R ((coefficientHomResolution.{r, u, v} J R).obj L) ⋙
        homFixed.{u, v, r} J R P)) ∧
    IsIso (colimit.post T
      (tensorFixed.{u, v, r} J R ((homFixed.{u, v, r} J R P).obj L)))
